name: Review
description: A considered review: the verdict up front, the good, the not-so-good, a closing line.

blocks.html: The verdict, up front — what it is, who it's for, and whether it's worth the money. Don't make the reader scroll for the answer.
What it gets right. Be specific — name the thing that actually made a difference, not the spec sheet.
Where it falls short. Be fair, but don't soften it into nothing — the honest niggles are the useful part.
A memorable line, or your one-line rating — the bit someone would screenshot.
Close it out: would you buy it again, and what you'd suggest instead if the answer is no.
